title: Cognitive OS Life Entry
description: The canonical envelope for one observation, measurement, or manually recorded life event.

id.description: Stable UUID for deduplication across SQLite, JSONL, and Git.

domain.description: Active domain name, such as health, work, relationships, or learning.

value.description: The observation or measurement. Keep the original meaning; do not invent a value.

unit.description: Unit for a numeric or measurable value; null when no unit applies.

notes.description: Human-readable context or the normalized transcript.

sentiment.description: Optional normalized sentiment score from -1 (negative) to 1 (positive).

energy.description: Optional self-reported or extracted energy level on a 1–10 scale.

timestamp.description: When the observation happened or was captured, as an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

source.description: Capture adapter that produced the record.

source_ref.description: Stable reference to the original recording, message, or note when available.

raw_text.description: Original transcript or text before categorization.

created_at.description: When this canonical record was written, as an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.
